chronicles.title: Labyrinth's Children
chronicles.description: In this modern-nights chronicle, you don't begin as chosen prodigies—you begin as prey. Abducted, mass-Embraced in the dark, and thrown into a deadly supernatural survival game, your newly-formed coterie must survive the night to earn your right to exist. But for those who escape the labyrinth, a far deadlier game awaits. Starting from the absolute bottom of Kindred society, you will carve a bloody path through the shadowy politics of the city. You will orchestrate heists, navigate sectarian warfare, and ultimately tear down the ancient masters who put you in the cage to begin with. You were embraced to be disposable pawns—but by the end of the nights, you will rule the board.

episodes.title: The Meat Grinder
episodes.concepts:
- Emphasize the Hunger mechanic immediately.
- The Vozhd (Tzimisce flesh dragon) is blind but tracks via sound; encourage stealth and distraction.
- Introduce the bloody graffiti as environmental storytelling.
episodes.hook: You awaken in dark and humid underground location. As you shift to situp, your hands feel slightly damp small rocks and pebbles below you. The crunch of the rocks against each other startles someone else nearby. You have no idea how you got here. The last thing you remember was a boring normal day in your neighborhood... You must find out where you are and get back home.
episodes.fallout_notes:
The players wake up in an unknown location underground.

The coterie runs into a small cavern tunnel to get away from the flesh dragon and find blood graffiti.

The coterie finds a room with a corpse holding a satchel charge and a table with a map.

They use the satchel to blow open a door and take a shortcut to the security section that will lead to the egress corridor.

As they exit the shortcut and step into a large well lit cavernous area they can see the security door wide open. The wall near it has large slash marks.

episodes.concepts:

- The dying guard NPC provides a moral dilemma: drain him to sate hunger or spare him for information?
- Foreshadow Rats' coterie trapped near the exit.
episodes.hook: With the beast temporarily evaded, the coterie discovers the sprawling nature of this underground gambling den. They realize wealthy elites are watching their struggle through reinforced glass and placing bets. They must navigate to the central control room to find the exit codes.

You've made it past the Flesh Dragon, but now you've got to find a way out.

Rachel, Matt, Ericca, Mariah, Michael

Someone is watching you from above through large windows. Perhaps a group of people even?

You may not know the purpose, but you know you must escape.

lore_entries.title: Flesh Dragon
lore_entries.content:
The loud speakers begin to click and stutter then a voice can be heard.

"Ladies and gentlemen, today I have something very special for you! Our great Tzimisce clan member has sponsored our Terror tonight! He is calling it the Flesh Dragon!

It is fearsome and hungry! Will our contestants manage to escape or will the Flesh Dragon consume them?!!!"

lore_entries.title: A Friendly Wager
lore_entries.content:
"There is no way a brand new fledgling coterie beats a beast like that... I mean come on. You think they're taking on a Wight?

10k says you're wrong my friend *chuckles*"

lore_entries.title: Sick Game
lore_entries.content: "Yeah, no the game is rigged. I'm telling you my friend... no way this Tzimisce puke actually made it fair. If you're gonna bet... bet on the Tzimisce."

lore_entries.title: No Way Out
lore_entries.content:
"Yes sir. All the entrances have been locked down or sealed like you requested.

Of course.

No, I'm certain there aren't any other contingencies we need to worry about."

lore_entries.title: Every Good Deed
lore_entries.content:
"This place... sometimes they put those they want to punish down here. Other times they find random kindred or humans and force them to survive.

Each game is more bizarre than the last. The previous game there were 5 groups of humans pit against each other with the promise of the last one standing getting to leave unharmed. That was a lie...

Those poor kids... fed upon by Sabbat they let lose as the 'Finale' in the worse way possible."

lore_entries.title: Kindred Generations
lore_entries.content:
"You idiots don't know anything.. just a bunch of licks who think they are still human. You won't last a day outside these walls... its a better mercy to die here.

Even worse... you might as well be thin-bloods considering how low you are on the totem pole.

Oh me? I'm a 9th generation who was sired by an elder of amazing power. You're sire is probably some new comer to this gambling ring that wanted to "chip in" during this round. Probably would've never been invited if he hadn't brought you as an offering... You're probably what? 12th gen? 11th gen at best."

lore_entries.title: Diablerie
lore_entries.content:
"Yeah, it might be foul when out in the actual city, but down here... I'll diablerize you for the sake of doing it. I won't even get anything other than a good laugh... stay out of my way."

Diablerie is the act of consuming another Kindred so thoroughly that you go down a generation and become more powerful than before.

personal_notes.title: Chronicle Outline (1920s–2010s)
personal_notes.content:
Vampire the Masquerade: The Louisville Chronicle

Theme: From Pawns to Kings, Through the Eras

Mood: Historical Survival transitioning into High-Stakes Political Thriller

Setting: Louisville, Kentucky. The chronicle spans a century, starting in the 1920s Prohibition Era, moving through the decades, climaxing during the historical Louisville-Jefferson County merger of 2003, and concluding in the Modern Nights.

Campaign Arc 1: The Meat Grinder (The 1920s)

Focus: Survival Horror, The First Amaranth

  • The Hook: The year is roughly 1926. The players (11th Generation fledglings) wake up in an underground gambling den—a pitch-black labyrinth beneath Prohibition-era Louisville.
  • The Plot: They are being hunted for sport by a flesh-made dragon (a horrifying Tzimisce Vozhd held together by blood magic). They must survive the labyrinth, avoid the beast, and find a way out.
  • The Climax: During their desperate escape, they encounter another coterie of fledglings trapped by the gamblers. These fledglings are of a lower generation (9th/10th Gen). The players are presented with a choice to accidentally or intentionally commit Diablerie on them, lowering their own generation early on. They escape into the 1920s night.

Campaign Arc 2: The Crossroads (The 1950s)

Focus: Choosing Sides, Street-Level Politics

  • The Hook: Time jumps forward. The players have survived as unaligned strays. An Anarch Baron rescues them from a perilous situation and offers them sanctuary if they act as their strike team.
  • The Plot: While working for the Anarchs, the Camarilla reaches out. Recognizing the coterie's growing strength, the Camarilla offers legitimacy, wealth, and backing if the players defect and betray the Anarchs.
  • The Climax: The coterie executes a pivotal mission where they must definitively choose their allegiance. The faction they side with becomes their permanent home; the other becomes a bitter enemy.

Campaign Arc 3: The House Always Loses (The 1980s)

Focus: Investigation and Revenge

  • The Hook: Established in their chosen sect in 1980s corporate Louisville, the coterie finally tracks down the elites who ran the gambling den that tortured them in Arc 1.
  • The Plot: The faction hosting this arc depends entirely on the players' choice in Arc 2. Their sect provides them with the resources to dismantle the Gambler's mortal financial empire and isolate him.
  • The Climax: The coterie raids the Gambler's heavily fortified haven, destroying him and formally claiming his vast resources and territory as their own Domain.

Campaign Arc 4: The Merger (Circa 2000-2003)

Focus: High Politics, City-Wide Unification, The Sanctioned Blood Hunt

  • The Hook: It is the turn of the millennium. Mortally, Louisville and Jefferson County are undergoing a historical, contentious merger. Vampirically, the city is heavily divided.
  • The Plot: The reigning Prince (or Baron, depending on sect) is revealed to be a treacherous traitor to the sect, selling out Kindred to their destruction. The players gather irrefutable proof and present it to a higher authority (a Justicar or Revolutionary Warlord).
  • The Climax: A Blood Hunt is legally sanctioned. Thanks to their generation drop in Arc 1, the coterie is powerful enough to battle the elder traitor. They defeat the traitor and commit legally sanctioned Diablerie, dropping their generation again without political backlash. One player claims Praxis/Barony, unifying Louisville under their banner.

Campaign Arc 5: The Inquisition Retaliation (Modern Day)

Focus: Global Stakes, The Ultimate Defense

  • The Hook: The year is roughly 2026. Having successfully unified a major metropolitan city, the coterie has drawn the ire of the mortal world.
  • The Plot: The Second Inquisition launches a massive, coordinated retaliation against the newly unified Louisville. The coterie must mobilize their entire city's resources to survive the onslaught.
  • The Climax: The coterie roots out the SI staging ground and breaks the siege. For their unprecedented victory and leadership, the global sect leaders elevate the coterie to the highest ranks of vampire society (e.g., the Inner Circle).

personal_notes.title: Arc 1 Story Tools: The Meat Grinder (1920s)
personal_notes.content:
Arc 1: The Meat Grinder (1920s) - Campaign Tools

Arc Summary

  • Beginning: Prohibition Era, 1920s Louisville. The players (11th Gen) wake up as blood-starved Fledglings trapped in a dark, underground gambling den.
  • Middle: They are hunted by a flesh-made dragon (a magical Tzimisce construct). They must avoid the beast while finding the exit.
  • End: Near the exit, they find a rival coterie of lower-generation fledglings incapacitated by the gamblers. The players commit Diablerie on them, lowering their generation (to ~9th/10th), and escape to the streets.

1. Pre-Campaign NPC Authoring (The 7-Point Profile)

NPC 1: Valerius (The Tzimisce Gambler)

1. Mask vs. Truth: A refined 1920s socialite (Mask) vs. A twisted fleshcrafter obsessed with evolution through suffering (Truth).

2. Current Want: To watch the new 11th Gen fledglings get torn apart by his Vozhd creation.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never physically enter the arena; views it as beneath him.

4. Mannerisms: Constantly adjusting an immaculately tailored suit; his flesh occasionally ripples unnaturally underneath.

5. Biases: Views high-generation vampires as literal cattle meant to feed his creations.

6. The Hidden Secret: The flesh-dragon is bound to a specific occult artifact in the arena's control room.

7. Active Memories: Views the coterie simply as "Bait."

NPC 2: "Rats" (The Trapped Rival Fledgling - 9th Gen)

1. Mask vs. Truth: Arrogant and superior (Mask) vs. Terrified and crippled by a trap (Truth).

2. Current Want: To convince the players to free him so he can escape.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never willingly offer his blood.

4. Mannerisms: Spits blood when he speaks; clutches a shattered leg.

5. Biases: Believes 11th Gens are weak and subservient.

6. The Hidden Secret: His sire is a powerful elder who was captured by Valerius; Rats' blood is exceptionally potent.

7. Active Memories: Sees the players as disposable pawns to trigger traps for him.

2. The Information Holder Matrix

Episode 1 Matrix: The Awakening

Episode Goal: Discover the rules of the gambling den and evade the flesh-dragon's first hunt.

  • Holder 1: The Bloody Graffiti (Location/Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Details the patrol pattern of the flesh-dragon, showing it relies on sound.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Written in the blood of previous victims, highlighting the hopelessness of the game.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Reveals a safe room hidden behind a collapsed speakeasy door.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): The graffiti was left by a mortal who realized the vampires were monsters too.
  • Holder 2: The Crushed Smuggler (Corpse)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Holds a map of the underground tunnels.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Died protecting a locket of his mortal family.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Carries a heavy explosive charge capable of collapsing a tunnel on the dragon.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): The smuggler was betrayed by Valerius, showing the Gambler's utter lack of honor.

Episode 2 Matrix: The Maze & The Rivals

Episode Goal: Navigate the labyrinth, find the control room, and locate the exit.

  • Holder 1: The Control Room Terminal (Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Contains the lockdown codes to open the outer vault doors.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Audio logs of wealthy elites betting on the players' deaths.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Reveals the magical artifact (a carved bone totem) controlling the dragon.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): The elites mention abandoning the "lower generation stock" (Rats' coterie) to rot.
  • Holder 2: The Dying Guard (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Knows the combination to the armory cache.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Begs for a quick death rather than being fed to the dragon.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Confesses that another group of fledglings is trapped in the exit corridor.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Feels deep remorse for participating in the horrific games.

Episode 3 Matrix: The First Amaranth (Climax)

Episode Goal: Bypass/defeat the dragon, encounter Rats' coterie, and commit Diablerie.

  • Holder 1: "Rats" (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Knows the final sequence to unseal the street-level grate.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Breaks down in fear, dropping his arrogant facade completely.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): His potent 9th Generation blood is thick and calls to the players' Beasts (Diablerie opportunity).
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): He reveals his Sire was a hero who tried to stop Valerius, making his death a tragic waste.
  • Holder 2: The Bone Totem (Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Destroying it temporarily stuns the flesh-dragon, allowing escape.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): It hums with the tortured souls of the mortals used to forge it.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Can be used to direct the dragon to attack the gamblers' viewing box instead.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): The totem was crafted from the remains of Valerius's own mortal children.

3. Objective, Layered Environment Design

Location: The Prohibition-Era Labyrinth

  • Layered Paths to the Exit:

1. Brute Force / Explosives: Use the smuggler's bomb to collapse the ceiling on the dragon.

2. Occult Sabotage: Steal the bone totem to turn the beast against its masters.

3. Stealth: Use the sound-based rules to sneak past the beast entirely.

4. The Immutable Plot Spine (Arc 1 Timeline)

  • Night 1: The flesh-dragon is released. If the players stay still, it finds them in 4 hours.
  • Night 2: Valerius floods the lower tunnels with toxic gas to force movement.
  • Night 3: The exit is permanently sealed off by concrete if not breached.

5. Proposed Episode Breakdown

Episode 1: The Awakening

  • Hook & Outline: The players (11th Gen fledglings) awaken in the pitch black of a Prohibition-era basement, utterly starved for blood. Panic sets in as a guttural, wet tearing sound echoes from the dark. They must find an exit before the flesh-dragon (a Vozhd) hunts them down.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Emphasize the Hunger mechanic immediately.
  • The Vozhd is blind but tracks via sound; encourage stealth and distraction.
  • Introduce the bloody graffiti as environmental storytelling.

Episode 2: The Labyrinth

  • Hook & Outline: With the beast temporarily evaded, the coterie discovers the sprawling nature of this underground gambling den. They realize wealthy elites are watching their struggle through reinforced glass and placing bets. They must navigate to the central control room to find the exit codes.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Puzzles involving old 1920s terminal switches and steam valves.
  • The dying guard NPC provides a moral dilemma: drain him to sate hunger or spare him for information?
  • Foreshadow Rats' coterie trapped near the exit.

Episode 3: The First Amaranth

  • Hook & Outline: The exit is in sight, but a rival coterie of 9th Gen fledglings (led by "Rats") is trapped in the egress corridor. The Vozhd is closing in. The players have a fatal choice: save the rivals, or commit Diablerie to lower their generation and gain the power to destroy the beast.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • High tension climax. The Beast within them roars at the scent of potent 9th Gen blood.
  • Combat with the Vozhd if they fail to sabotage the Bone Totem.
  • The mechanical and narrative consequences of Diablerie (stains on Humanity).

Episode 4: Respite Part 1

  • Hook & Outline: The players burst out onto the rainy streets of 1920s Louisville. They are free, but their blood is thicker, their Beasts are louder, and they are completely exposed to the mortal world. They must find shelter before the sun rises.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • A palate-cleanser episode focusing on the struggle to adapt to their new generation.
  • First proper hunting scene in the city.
  • Dealing with the psychological fallout of their actions in the Meat Grinder.

Episode 5: Respite Part 2

  • Hook & Outline: With temporary shelter secured, the coterie must establish a permanent haven in a city controlled by Prohibition mobsters and hidden Kindred factions. They begin to hear whispers of the broader supernatural society they've just violently entered.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Domain building and resource management.
  • Introduce minor local NPCs (ghouls, informants).
  • Lay the narrative groundwork for the time skip to the 1950s.

personal_notes.title: Arc 2 Story Tools: The Neon Noose (1950s)
personal_notes.content:
Arc 2: The Crossroads (1950s) - Campaign Tools

Arc Summary

  • Beginning: Fast forward to the 1950s. The players have survived independently but are caught in a bad spot. An Anarch Baron rescues them and recruits them as a strike team.
  • Middle: The Camarilla, noticing their potency (thanks to the Arc 1 diablerie), secretly reaches out with an offer to defect.
  • End: A pivotal raid on a highly contested target forces the coterie to choose. They execute the mission for one side, permanently making enemies of the other.

1. Pre-Campaign NPC Authoring (The 7-Point Profile)

NPC 1: Baroness "Jax" (The Anarch Patron)

1. Mask vs. Truth: A greaser rebel fighting for freedom (Mask) vs. A pragmatic warlord (Truth).

2. Current Want: To use the coterie to secure the industrial docks from the Camarilla.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never betray a sworn comrade.

4. Mannerisms: Smokes constantly; wears a leather jacket with patches of fallen allies.

5. Biases: Hates "suits" and the ivory tower elite.

6. The Hidden Secret: Her territory is failing, and she desperately needs a victory to maintain control over her gangs.

7. Active Memories: Views the coterie as wild cards with immense potential.

NPC 2: Seneschal Montgomery (The Camarilla Recruiter)

1. Mask vs. Truth: A polite, helpful mentor (Mask) vs. A manipulative slaver (Truth).

2. Current Want: To poach the coterie to weaken Jax and gain powerful enforcers.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never break a formal oath.

4. Mannerisms: Impeccable posture; habitually smooths his lapels.

5. Biases: Views Anarchs as rabid dogs.

6. The Hidden Secret: He is acting without the Prince's permission; if his bribe fails, he is politically vulnerable.

7. Active Memories: Sees the coterie as rough gems to be polished.

2. The Information Holder Matrix

Episode 6 Matrix: The Anarch's Leash

Episode Goal: Prove their worth to Jax by investigating a Camarilla smuggling front at the docks.

  • Holder 1: The Dockmaster's Ledger (Location/Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Lists the schedule of Camarilla blood shipments.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Shows the Camarilla is exploiting impoverished 1950s dock workers.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Reveals a secret weapons cache belonging to Montgomery.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Contains evidence that the Camarilla is deliberately starving Anarch territories.
  • Holder 2: "Slick", the Defector (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Knows the patrol routes of the Camarilla ghouls.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Is terrified of Camarilla retaliation.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Possesses the master key to the smuggling warehouse.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Reveals that Jax's previous strike team was massacred here due to bad intel.

Episode 7 Matrix: The Camarilla's Bribe

Episode Goal: Meet with Montgomery secretly and uncover the truth behind his offer.

  • Holder 1: The Elysium Coat-Check (Location/Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Contains a briefcase with Montgomery's formal contract offer.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): The contract includes deeds to luxurious 1950s estates.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): A hidden wiretap reveals Montgomery plans to blood-bond the coterie eventually.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Shows Montgomery views them strictly as attack dogs, not equals.
  • Holder 2: Kincaid, the Hound (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Outlines the Camarilla's exact tactical plan to wipe out Jax.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): He is bound by honor and respects the coterie's martial prowess.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Confesses that Montgomery is acting without the Prince's blessing.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Kincaid hates Montgomery and hopes the coterie humiliates him.

Episode 8 Matrix: The Decisive Raid (Climax)

Episode Goal: Execute the warehouse raid and definitively choose a faction.

  • Holder 1: The Shipment Manifest (Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Reveals the cargo is highly volatile explosives.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): The explosives were meant to level the Anarch bar.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Can be re-routed to blow up Montgomery's haven instead.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): The manifest is signed by the Prince, meaning this war is officially sanctioned.
  • Holder 2: The Captured Ghoul (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Knows the override codes to the warehouse vault.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Begs for his mortal family's safety.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Knows exactly where Jax/Montgomery will be waiting for the mission debrief.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Reveals that whichever side they choose, the other side will execute a blood hunt on them tomorrow.

3. Objective, Layered Environment Design

Location: The 1950s Smuggling Warehouse

  • Layered Paths to the Target:

1. Frontal Assault: Fight through the Camarilla ghouls to secure the shipment.

2. Sabotage (Anarch Choice): Blow the warehouse sky high.

3. Infiltration (Camarilla Choice): Secure the vault silently and hand the keys to Montgomery.

4. The Immutable Plot Spine (Arc 2 Timeline)

  • Night 1: Jax orders the raid.
  • Night 2: Montgomery makes his secret offer.
  • Night 3: If the coterie does nothing, the Camarilla successfully bombs the Anarch bar, wiping out Jax and leaving the coterie hunted by both sides.

5. Proposed Episode Breakdown

Episode 6: The Leash

  • Hook & Outline: Fast forward to the 1950s. The coterie, now somewhat established, is forced to repay a debt to Baroness Jax. She orders them to investigate a Camarilla smuggling front at the docks. It's a suicide mission to test their loyalty.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Establish the 1950s greaser/noir aesthetic.
  • Introduce Jax's brutal, pragmatic leadership style.
  • The docks are heavily guarded; stealth vs. combat.

Episode 7: The Bribe

  • Hook & Outline: While executing Jax's mission, the coterie is covertly intercepted by Seneschal Montgomery. In a quiet, tense Elysium coat-check, he offers them a way out of the Anarchs' squalor—deeds to estates and high status, if they turn on Jax.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Heavy social roleplay with Montgomery.
  • Reveal that Montgomery is acting illegally without the Prince's permission.
  • The coterie must investigate his true motives before the warehouse raid.

Episode 8: The Crossroads (Climax)

  • Hook & Outline: The night of the raid has arrived. The coterie stands outside the Camarilla warehouse. They must execute the mission for Jax, betray her to secure the vault for Montgomery, or forge a chaotic third path.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • The warehouse is rigged with explosives.
  • Whichever side they betray will immediately declare a Blood Hunt.
  • High stakes combat and immediate consequences based on their choice.

Episode 9: Respite Part 1

  • Hook & Outline: The immediate fallout of the raid. The coterie is officially inducted into their chosen sect (Anarch or Camarilla) in a tense, formal ceremony, but they are now marked targets for the opposing faction.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Roleplay the induction rites.
  • Assess the damage from the raid.
  • Deal with assassins or retaliatory strikes from the betrayed sect.

Episode 10: Respite Part 2

  • Hook & Outline: The coterie is granted official Domain in 1950s Louisville as a reward. They must secure their new territory, deal with mortal organized crime, and prepare for the long cold war ahead.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Expanding Haven merits and Backgrounds.
  • Deepening relationships with their sect's key NPCs.
  • Foreshadowing the technological shifts of the 1980s.

personal_notes.title: Arc 3 Story Tools: Greed is Good (1980s)
personal_notes.content:
Arc 3: The House Always Loses (1980s) - Campaign Tools

Arc Summary

  • Beginning: 1980s corporate Louisville. The coterie uses their established sect resources to hunt down Valerius, the gambler from Arc 1.
  • Middle: The faction hosting the mission (Camarilla or Anarch) provides the backing to dismantle Valerius's mortal financial empire.
  • End: The coterie breaches his high-rise haven, corners him, and destroys him, claiming his vast wealth and territory.

1. Pre-Campaign NPC Authoring (The 7-Point Profile)

NPC 1: Valerius (The Gambler, Now a Corporate Elite)

1. Mask vs. Truth: A sleek 1980s corporate raider (Mask) vs. The same sadistic fleshcrafter (Truth).

2. Current Want: To erase his past connections to the 1920s underground arena.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never fight fairly; uses corporate lawyers and heavily armed mercenaries.

4. Mannerisms: Snorts vitae like cocaine; wears mirrored aviators indoors.

5. Biases: Looks down on anyone who isn't wealthy.

6. The Hidden Secret: His corporate empire is a house of cards leveraged in massive debt.

7. Active Memories: Remembers the coterie as the anomalies that escaped him.

NPC 2: The Sect Liaison (Depends on Arc 2 Choice)

1. Mask vs. Truth: Supportive ally (Mask) vs. Opportunistic politician (Truth).

2. Current Want: To see Valerius fall so they can absorb his territory.

3. Line in the Sand: Will not openly declare war on Valerius without proof of his crimes.

4. Mannerisms: Constantly checking a bulky 1980s brick cell phone.

5. Biases: Distrusts the opposing sect entirely.

6. The Hidden Secret: They plan to tax the coterie heavily once Valerius's assets are seized.

7. Active Memories: Views the coterie as highly effective hitmen.

2. The Information Holder Matrix

Episode 11 Matrix: The Breadcrumbs

Episode Goal: Locate Valerius's modern financial fronts.

  • Holder 1: The Offshore Bank Ledger (Location/Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Lists the exact locations of Valerius's shell companies.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Reveals he has been bankrupting mortal families for amusement.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Contains the master override codes to the reinforced UV-glass windows of his penthouse.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Shows that he has been selling out members of his own sect to the SI.
  • Holder 2: Detective Miller (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Knows the patrol routes of Valerius's elite ghoul security team.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Is forced to coordinate them against her will (blood bond).
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Has the physical key to his underground panic room.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Will only hand it over if the coterie swears to cure her blood-addiction.

Episode 12 Matrix: The Blackmail

Episode Goal: Gather irrefutable proof to get the sect's blessing to attack.

  • Holder 1: The VHS Security Tapes (Location/Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Shows Valerius explicitly breaking the Masquerade.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Features Valerius torturing innocent mortals in his boardroom.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Identifies the exact time the penthouse security grid reboots daily.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): The tapes reveal Valerius is deeply terrified of the coterie's return.
  • Holder 2: The Disgruntled Hacker (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Can crash Valerius's stock portfolio in real-time.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Hates Valerius for ruining his father's life.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Can slice the elevator controls to give the coterie VIP access to the penthouse.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Is secretly a ghoul to an opposing elder, complicating the politics.

Episode 13 Matrix: The Raid (Climax)

Episode Goal: Breach the penthouse and destroy Valerius.

  • Holder 1: The Penthouse Blueprints (Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Highlights the structural weak points of the helipad.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Designed by an architect Valerius later murdered.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Shows a hidden flesh-crafting lab behind the executive washroom.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): The lab contains twisted remnants of Rats' old coterie from the 1920s.
  • Holder 2: The Mercenary Captain (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Will stand his men down if shown proof Valerius's accounts are frozen.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Respects the coterie's lethality over his boss's cowardice.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Carries a heavy incendiary weapon capable of bypassing Valerius's armor.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Disgusts Valerius's occult practices and wants out of the contract.

3. Objective, Layered Environment Design

Location: The Sapphire Corporate Penthouse

  • Layered Paths to the Target:

1. Financial Ruin (Social/Tech): Crash his stocks; the mercenaries abandon him.

2. Air Assault (Combat): Parachute/grapple to the helipad.

3. The Panic Room (Infiltration): Use Miller's key to wait in his safe room.

4. The Immutable Plot Spine (Arc 3 Timeline)

  • Night 1: Valerius puts a bounty on the coterie.
  • Night 3: Ghoul hit-squads attack the coterie's haven.
  • Night 5: Valerius liquidates his assets and flees the city permanently via helicopter.

5. Proposed Episode Breakdown

Episode 11: The Grid

  • Hook & Outline: The neon-drenched 1980s. A rogue Nosferatu information broker, "Glitch," has stolen a hard drive containing the true identities of every Kindred in Louisville. The coterie is hired to track him through the burgeoning digital underground.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Introduce 1980s tech (early hacking, BBS boards, synthwave aesthetic).
  • Glitch's traps are both digital and physical.
  • The coterie must navigate a rave club to find his contact.

Episode 12: The Leak

  • Hook & Outline: The coterie corners Glitch, only to discover the SI (Second Inquisition prototype task force) is already closing in on the drive. They must extract the data while avoiding a heavily armed mortal swat team that knows their weaknesses.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Introduce the terrifying threat of the SI (incendiary rounds, tactical coordination).
  • Combat is highly lethal; emphasize evasion and covering tracks.
  • A difficult choice: destroy the drive to keep it from the SI, or risk everything to steal it back?

Episode 13: The Blackout (Climax)

  • Hook & Outline: The SI has tracked the coterie's escape route and is launching a coordinated raid on the city's power grid to trap them. The players must plunge the city into a blackout to blind the SI and escape with the encrypted drive.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • A ticking clock scenario.
  • High-speed chases and chaotic street combat.
  • The fallout of causing a city-wide blackout (Masquerade breach vs. survival).

Episode 14: Respite Part 1

  • Hook & Outline: The city is dark, and the SI is hunting. The coterie must lay low in a secure safehouse, nursing their wounds and attempting to decrypt the hard drive they bled for.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Tense, claustrophobic roleplay.
  • Dealing with limited resources during the blackout.
  • The revelation of what's actually on the drive.

Episode 15: Respite Part 2

  • Hook & Outline: Power is restored. The coterie uses the leverage from the decrypted drive to secure immense political power within their sect, elevating their status right before the turn of the millennium.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Political maneuvering and cashing in favors.
  • Upgrading their Domain and resources significantly.
  • Setting the stage for the modern nights.

personal_notes.title: Arc 4 Story Tools: The Merger (2003)
personal_notes.content:
Arc 4: The Merger (Circa 2000-2003) - Campaign Tools

Arc Summary

  • Beginning: The turn of the millennium. Louisville and Jefferson County are undergoing a historical merger. The vampire factions are fiercely divided over who controls the unified city.
  • Middle: The players discover that the current reigning Prince (or Baron) is a traitor, selling out their own sect to the Second Inquisition to maintain control. The players gather proof and present it to a global sect leader (Justicar or Warlord).
  • End: A Blood Hunt is sanctioned. Because of their Arc 1 generation drop, the players are powerful enough to battle and Diablerize the 7th/8th Gen traitor with legal immunity. One player unifies the city by claiming Praxis/Barony.

1. Pre-Campaign NPC Authoring (The 7-Point Profile)

NPC 1: The Traitor (Prince/Baron)

1. Mask vs. Truth: A visionary leader guiding the city's merger (Mask) vs. A desperate tyrant collaborating with hunters to stay in power (Truth).

2. Current Want: To use the merger as cover to execute all political rivals via SI strikes.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never willingly surrender power or step down.

4. Mannerisms: Speaks in grand, historical metaphors; always has a glass of ancient vintage blood.

5. Biases: Views younger vampires as inherently disposable.

6. The Hidden Secret: He has a direct radio link to an SI Commander, feeding them locations of rival havens.

7. Active Memories: Views the coterie as his most dangerous, imminent threat.

NPC 2: Justicar/Warlord (The Arbiter)

1. Mask vs. Truth: Impartial judge (Mask) vs. Ruthless executioner seeking an excuse to purge the city (Truth).

2. Current Want: Irrefutable proof of the Traitor's crimes before acting.

3. Line in the Sand: Will not act on hearsay; requires hard evidence.

4. Mannerisms: Unblinking stare; perfectly still.

5. Biases: Respects raw power and ambition above all else.

6. The Hidden Secret: Plans to install the coterie as rulers because they are easier to manipulate (or so they think).

7. Active Memories: Intrigued by the coterie's meteoric rise since the 1920s.

2. The Information Holder Matrix

Episode 16 Matrix: The Betrayal

Episode Goal: Uncover the Traitor's collaboration with the SI.

  • Holder 1: The Burner Phone (Location/Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Contains encrypted texts to an SI hit squad.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Shows the Traitor specifically sold out a beloved NPC ally of the coterie.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Reveals the SI frequency and the location of the Traitor's secret transmitter.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Contains a draft of the Traitor's speech, planning to feign grief over the dead allies.
  • Holder 2: The Disillusioned Hound (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Witnessed the Traitor handing over daylight haven addresses to hunters.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Is deeply ashamed of their failure to protect their sect.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Possesses the security bypass for the Traitor's inner sanctum.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Will swear a life-boon to the coterie if they avenge his fallen comrades.

Episode 17 Matrix: The Sanction

Episode Goal: Present the evidence to the Arbiter and secure the Blood Hunt.

  • Holder 1: The Arbiter's Chamberlain (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Knows the specific legal precedents needed to justify a Blood Hunt.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Despises the Traitor for a slight committed centuries ago.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Can grant the coterie a private audience with the Arbiter.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Will secretly back the coterie for Praxis if they promise him a Primogen seat.
  • Holder 2: The Intercepted SI Dossier (Location/Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Hard, physical proof of the Traitor's signature on a treaty with hunters.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Shows the hunters consider the Traitor a pathetic coward.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Lists the exact layout of the Traitor's panic room defenses.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Reveals the Traitor was planning to sell out the coterie tonight.

Episode 18 Matrix: The Civil War (Setup)

Episode Goal: Fight through the Traitor's elite guard to reach him.

  • Holder 1: The Head of Security (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Commands the elite guard blocking the Sanctum.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Is fanatically blood-bonded to the Traitor.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Can be bypassed entirely if the coterie destroys the blood-ward anchors in the courtyard.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): In his lucid moments, he prays for someone to kill him.
  • Holder 2: The Blood-Ward Anchors (Location/Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Disabling them drops the magical shields on the Sanctum.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Forged from the vitae of the Traitor's own childer.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Reversing the polarity traps the Traitor inside his own panic room with no escape.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): The magic echoes with the agonizing screams of the betrayed.

3. Objective, Layered Environment Design

Location: The Grand City Hall (The Sanctum)

  • Layered Paths to the Target:

1. The Shadow Vote (Social): Present the Arbiter's decree to the guards, forcing them to stand down legally.

2. The Blackout (Infiltration): Sabotage the blood-wards and cut the power, sneaking past the elite guard in the dark.

3. Total War (Combat): A brutal frontal assault through the courtyard.

4. The Immutable Plot Spine (Arc 4 Timeline)

  • Night 1: The Traitor realizes he's been discovered and initiates a city-wide purge.
  • Night 2: The Arbiter arrives in the city; if the coterie doesn't reach them, the Arbiter sides with the Traitor to maintain order.
  • Night 3: The SI executes daylight raids on the coterie's havens based on the Traitor's intel.

5. Proposed Episode Breakdown

Episode 16: The Beckoning

  • Hook & Outline: Present day (2000s). The Elders of Louisville are disappearing, called away by the Beckoning. The city's power structure collapses overnight. The coterie must secure key territories before rival ambitious neonates seize them.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • A massive power vacuum creates chaos.
  • Turf wars with rival coteries.
  • The realization that their old mentors are gone for good.

Episode 17: The Vacuum

  • Hook & Outline: A prominent Elder's haven is left completely unguarded. The coterie races to loot its ancient artifacts and blood bonds, but they aren't the only ones who know about it. A lethal three-way standoff ensues.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Dungeon crawl through an ancient, trap-filled haven.
  • Negotiating or fighting with rival scavengers.
  • Uncovering a terrifying prophecy about the city's foundation.

Episode 18: The Ascension (Climax)

  • Hook & Outline: To definitively claim control of the city, the coterie must host a grand summit of all remaining Kindred and force them to bend the knee, either through diplomacy, blackmail, or sheer violence.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • The ultimate social/political episode.
  • Using every favor, secret, and asset they've gathered since the 1920s.
  • Fending off an assassination attempt during the summit.

Episode 19: Respite Part 1

  • Hook & Outline: The dust settles. The coterie are now the de facto rulers (or prime barons) of Louisville. They must delegate the mundane tasks of rule and deal with the crushing weight of their new responsibilities.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • High-level domain management.
  • Resolving minor disputes among their new subjects.
  • The paranoia of leadership.

Episode 20: Respite Part 2

  • Hook & Outline: A quiet night holding court. But a lone, bloodied messenger arrives with a warning: The true masters of the city, ancient beings slumbering beneath the bedrock, are beginning to stir.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • A narrative bridge to the final, apocalyptic arc.
  • Introduce the subtle dread of Gehenna.
  • Finalizing their strongholds.

personal_notes.title: Arc 5 Story Tools: Endgame (2010s)
personal_notes.content:
Arc 5: The Inquisition Retaliation (Modern Day) - Campaign Tools

Arc Summary

  • Beginning: Modern nights (2020s). The players are the established Princes/Barons of unified Louisville. The Second Inquisition, furious over their lost foothold, launches a massive, coordinated siege on the city.
  • Middle: The coterie must mobilize their city's defenses, protect their mortal Touchstones, and locate the SI's hidden staging ground.
  • End: The ultimate climax. The coterie leads a massive counter-offensive against the SI Commander. They break the blockade, securing Louisville forever, and are elevated to the Inner Circle of global vampire society.

1. Pre-Campaign NPC Authoring (The 7-Point Profile)

NPC 1: Commander Striker (The SI Leader)

1. Mask vs. Truth: A righteous protector of humanity (Mask) vs. A fanatical zealot willing to burn the city down (Truth).

2. Current Want: To capture the coterie alive for vivisection and sun-testing.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never negotiate or compromise with "Blankbodies."

4. Mannerisms: Uses excessive military jargon; always wears UV-reflective tactical gear.

5. Biases: Believes all vampires are mindless parasites with no humanity left.

6. The Hidden Secret: His funding is running out; if he doesn't secure a high-profile kill soon, the government will disband his unit.

7. Active Memories: Views the coterie as his ultimate white whale.

NPC 2: The Global Envoy (Justicar/Inner Circle Member)

1. Mask vs. Truth: Demanding superior (Mask) vs. Desperate elder terrified of the SI (Truth).

2. Current Want: To see if the coterie can actually hold a city against a full SI siege to prove it's possible.

3. Line in the Sand: Will not risk their own unlife in combat.

4. Mannerisms: Projects absolute calm while the city burns around them.

5. Biases: Treats anyone below 8th generation as expendable fodder.

6. The Hidden Secret: They deliberately leaked a small amount of intel to the SI to trigger this stress-test of the coterie's leadership.

7. Active Memories: Highly respects the coterie's power, but fears their ambition.

2. The Information Holder Matrix

Episode 21 Matrix: The Blockade

Episode Goal: Survive the initial SI lockdown and identify their surveillance network.

  • Holder 1: The Downed SI Drone (Location/Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Contains the flight paths mapping out the city's Kindred havens.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Records audio of SI operators laughing about collateral mortal damage.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Reveals the encryption key to the SI's tactical radio network.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Shows the SI has been monitoring the coterie's mortal Touchstones for months.
  • Holder 2: The Captured Informant (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): A mortal who points out the unmarked vans the SI uses for daylight snatch-and-grabs.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): He only informed because the SI threatened his family.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Knows the location of a secondary SI supply depot.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Reveals the SI plans to use weaponized sunlight grenades against the coterie.

Episode 22 Matrix: The Investigation

Episode Goal: Discover the location of Commander Striker's primary staging ground.

  • Holder 1: The Supply Depot Terminal (Location/Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Tracks logistics shipments directly to an abandoned Water Treatment Plant.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Requisitions orders for silver, stakes, and heavy incendiaries.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Contains the blueprints for the Water Treatment Plant's defenses.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Reveals the Envoy's secret correspondence with the SI (the betrayal).
  • Holder 2: The Rogue Agent (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): An SI sniper who realizes Striker is out of control and wants to defect.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Is haunted by the atrocities committed in the name of God.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Can disable the UV perimeter grid at the staging ground.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Asks the coterie to spare his squadmates who are just following orders.

Episode 23 Matrix: The Counter-Offensive (Setup)

Episode Goal: Rally the city's factions and prepare the assault on the staging ground.

  • Holder 1: The Allied Primogen/Baron (NPC)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Offers their clan's elite fighters to storm the front gates.
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): Finally puts aside centuries of petty rivalry to follow the coterie's lead.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Possesses a massive underground drilling vehicle to breach the facility from below.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Entrusts the coterie with their clan's most sacred relic for the battle.
  • Holder 2: The Armory Cache (Location/Object)
  • Tier 1 (Plot): Stockpiled military-grade hardware (C4, assault rifles, body armor).
  • Tier 1 (Emotional): A testament to how far the coterie has come since the 1920s.
  • Tier 2 (Plot): Contains experimental anti-UV smoke grenades.
  • Tier 2 (Emotional): Left behind by a mentor from Arc 2 who believed in them.

3. Objective, Layered Environment Design

Location: The Water Treatment Plant (SI Staging Ground)

  • Layered Paths to the Target:

1. The Siege (Combat): Lead the Kindred army in a massive, bloody frontal assault against the barricades.

2. The Subterranean Breach (Agility/Combat): Use the drilling vehicle to pop up directly inside Striker's command center.

3. The Hacker's Route (Tech/Stealth): Have the Rogue Agent drop the UV grid, allowing the coterie to infiltrate silently and assassinate Striker before the alarm sounds.

4. The Immutable Plot Spine (Arc 5 Timeline)

  • Night 1: The SI blockades all bridges and roads out of Louisville.
  • Night 3: Striker initiates daylight purging of the outer city domains.
  • Night 5: The SI launches a coordinated strike on City Hall (the coterie's seat of power), destroying the Kindred presence in Louisville forever.

5. Proposed Episode Breakdown

Episode 21: The Tremor

  • Hook & Outline: The modern nights (2020s). The earth beneath Louisville shakes, and the blood in the coterie's veins burns. An ancient Methuselah has awakened beneath the city, and its hunger is driving all local Kindred into a frenzy.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Mechanics for dealing with forced frenzy checks.
  • The city descends into chaos as the Masquerade shatters.
  • Investigating the epicenter of the awakening.

Episode 22: The Blood Hunt

  • Hook & Outline: The Methuselah takes control of the local Sheriff, who declares a city-wide Blood Hunt on the coterie. They are hunted by their own former subjects and allies. They must find the ancient's resting place to cut off its control.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Surviving betrayal from trusted NPCs.
  • Desperate, guerrilla warfare against overwhelming odds.
  • Discovering the entrance to the ancient catacombs.

Episode 23: The Gehenna Protocol (Climax)

  • Hook & Outline: The coterie descends into the deepest catacombs beneath Louisville to confront the awakened Methuselah. They must use the accumulated artifacts, knowledge, and power from the past century to put the ancient back to sleep—or destroy it.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Epic, multi-stage boss encounter.
  • The environment is crumbling and warping due to ancient blood magic.
  • The ultimate test of their humanity and survival.

Episode 24: The Ashes (Epilogue Part 1)

  • Hook & Outline: The immediate aftermath of the final battle. The coterie emerges from the catacombs to see the sun rising over a forever-changed Louisville. They must decide whether to stay and rebuild the ashes, or leave the city behind forever.
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Tying up loose ends with surviving NPCs.
  • A somber reflection on the centuries they've survived.
  • Final character arcs resolved.

Episode 25: The Eternal Night (Epilogue Part 2)

  • Hook & Outline: A narrative flash-forward. We see the final, ultimate fate of each player character based on the choices they made throughout the chronicle. Are they rulers, monsters, or dust on the wind?
  • Outline / Concepts:
  • Collaborative storytelling with the players to narrate their endings.
  • Final distribution of XP (for posterity).
  • The curtain closes on the Chronicle.

personal_notes.title: NPC Cast & 7-Point Profiles
personal_notes.content:
Louisville Chronicle - NPC Cast

This document provides the core character sheet information and the 7-Point Storyteller Profile for all major NPCs in the century-spanning Louisville Chronicle.

1. Valerius (The Fleshcrafter Gambler)

Basic Information

  • Name: Valerius
  • Gender/Pronouns: Male (He/Him)
  • Concept: Aristocratic fleshcrafter / Corporate raider
  • Predator: Extortionist
  • Chronicle: The Louisville Chronicle
  • Ambition: To achieve perfect physical evolution through the suffering of others.
  • Clan: Tzimisce
  • Organization: Independent (Former Sabbat)
  • Sire: Unknown Old World Tzimisce
  • Desire: To break the spirit of the coterie and use their bodies for a new Vozhd.
  • Generation: 7th
  • Blood Potency: 4
  • True Age: ~350 years
  • Apparent Age: Late 30s
  • Date of Birth: Mid 1600s
  • Date of Death: Late 1600s

Appearance: Impeccably tailored suits (1920s bespoke, later 1980s power suits). His features are slightly too* perfect, creating an uncanny valley effect.

  • Distinguishing Features: His flesh occasionally ripples underneath his clothes; unnervingly symmetrical face.
  • History: Valerius arrived in America during the Gilded Age. In the 1920s, he ran underground blood sports. By the 1980s, he adapted his sadism into cutthroat corporate raiding.

7-Point Profile

1. Mask vs. Truth: A refined socialite/businessman (Mask) vs. A twisted monster obsessed with pain (Truth).

2. Current Want: To watch the fledglings suffer in his games.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never willingly enter physical combat unless forced.

4. Mannerisms: Constantly adjusting his suit; uses vitae-scented wipes.

5. Biases: Views high-generation vampires as literal cattle.

6. The Hidden Secret: His 1980s corporate empire is a house of cards built on debt.

7. Active Memories: Remembers the coterie as the anomalies who ruined his perfect 1920s game.

2. "Rats" (The Trapped Rival Fledgling)

Basic Information

  • Name: "Rats" (Real name forgotten or hidden)
  • Concept: Arrogant fledgling born of potent blood
  • Predator: Alleycat
  • Chronicle: The Louisville Chronicle
  • Ambition: To survive the labyrinth and prove his superiority.
  • Clan: Ventrue
  • Organization: Camarilla (Unclaimed Fledgling)
  • Sire: A powerful, missing Elder
  • Desire: To manipulate the coterie into triggering the traps so he can escape.
  • Generation: 9th
  • Blood Potency: 2
  • True Age: 1 year (as of 1926)
  • Apparent Age: Early 20s
  • Date of Birth: 1904
  • Date of Death: 1925
  • Appearance: Covered in dirt, blood, and torn 1920s street clothes.
  • Distinguishing Features: A shattered leg (from an arena trap), spits blood when he speaks.
  • History: Embraced purely for his potent mortal lineage, Rats was captured by Valerius almost immediately after his Embrace to serve as high-tier fodder for the games.

7-Point Profile

1. Mask vs. Truth: Arrogant and superior (Mask) vs. Terrified and crippled (Truth).

2. Current Want: To convince the players to free him.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never willingly offer his blood to a higher generation.

4. Mannerisms: Spits blood; clutches his shattered leg defensively.

5. Biases: Believes 11th Gen vampires are weak, subservient trash.

6. The Hidden Secret: His Sire was a hero who tried to stop Valerius; his death is a tragic waste of a legacy.

7. Active Memories: Sees the players as disposable pawns.

3. Baroness "Jax" (The Anarch Patron)

Basic Information

  • Name: Jax
  • Concept: 1950s Greaser Warlord
  • Predator: Blood Leech (feeds on rival Kindred)
  • Chronicle: The Louisville Chronicle
  • Ambition: To drive the Camarilla out of the industrial sectors completely.
  • Clan: Brujah
  • Organization: Anarch
  • Sire: A fallen WWII Anarch veteran
  • Desire: To turn the coterie into her most lethal, unquestioning strike team.
  • Generation: 9th
  • Blood Potency: 3
  • True Age: ~60 years (as of 1950s)
  • Apparent Age: Mid 20s
  • Date of Birth: 1870s
  • Date of Death: 1890s
  • Appearance: Leather jackets adorned with patches of fallen allies; slicked-back hair, grease on her hands.
  • Distinguishing Features: A massive, jagged scar across her throat that never healed.
  • History: Fought in early labor riots. She sees the Anarch cause as a continuation of mortal labor struggles against oppressive barons.

7-Point Profile

1. Mask vs. Truth: A rebellious freedom fighter (Mask) vs. A calculating warlord running a cult of personality (Truth).

2. Current Want: To secure the industrial docks from the Camarilla.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never ally with Tremere or "suits."

4. Mannerisms: Chain-smokes; affectionately calls her gang "blood-kin."

5. Biases: Deeply prejudiced against Ventrue and anyone who flaunts wealth.

6. The Hidden Secret: She is losing her grip on her territory and desperately needs a win to prevent a mutiny.

7. Active Memories: Views the coterie as wild cards with immense, usable potential.

4. Seneschal Montgomery (The Camarilla Recruiter)

Basic Information

  • Name: Seneschal Montgomery
  • Gender/Pronouns: Male (He/Him)
  • Concept: Manipulative Ivory Tower Slaver
  • Predator: Scene Queen
  • Chronicle: The Louisville Chronicle
  • Ambition: To usurp his Prince and take control of the city.
  • Clan: Toreador
  • Organization: Camarilla
  • Sire: A French aristocrat
  • Desire: To poach the coterie from Jax and blood-bond them as his secret enforcers.
  • Generation: 8th
  • Blood Potency: 3
  • True Age: ~150 years
  • Apparent Age: Early 40s
  • Date of Birth: 1760s
  • Date of Death: 1800s
  • Appearance: Impeccable posture, perfectly tailored three-piece suits. Never a hair out of place.
  • Distinguishing Features: Cold, dead eyes that contradict his warm, inviting smile.
  • History: Rose to power by selling out his own mortal descendants to secure boons from older vampires.

7-Point Profile

1. Mask vs. Truth: A helpful, polite mentor (Mask) vs. A cold-blooded slaver who views younger vampires as property (Truth).

2. Current Want: To weaken Jax by stealing her best fighters.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never break a formally sworn Oath or Boast.

4. Mannerisms: Habitually smooths his lapels or adjusts his cuffs when lying.

5. Biases: Views all Anarchs as rabid dogs.

6. The Hidden Secret: He is acting without the Prince's permission; his bribe is highly illegal within his sect.

7. Active Memories: Sees the coterie as unpolished diamonds needing strict discipline.

5. Kincaid (The Honorable Duelist)

Basic Information

  • Name: Kincaid
  • Gender/Pronouns: Male (He/Him)
  • Concept: Bound executioner with a mortal code
  • Predator: Sandman
  • Chronicle: The Louisville Chronicle
  • Ambition: To find a warrior skilled enough to finally defeat him in fair combat.
  • Clan: Banu Haqim
  • Organization: Camarilla
  • Sire: An ancient Middle-Eastern assassin
  • Desire: To test the coterie's martial prowess.
  • Generation: 10th
  • Blood Potency: 2
  • True Age: ~200 years
  • Apparent Age: 30s
  • Date of Birth: 1790s
  • Date of Death: 1820s
  • Appearance: Minimalist, functional clothing. Carries a beautifully maintained cavalry saber.
  • Distinguishing Features: Moves in complete, unnatural silence.
  • History: A former mortal duelist bound into eternal servitude by Montgomery through a life-debt.

7-Point Profile

1. Mask vs. Truth: A silent, obedient executioner (Mask) vs. A warrior desperate for an honorable death (Truth).

2. Current Want: To protect Montgomery and assess the coterie's skill.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never use supernatural Disciplines in a formal, declared duel.

4. Mannerisms: Bows formally before drawing his weapon; refuses to strike an unarmed opponent.

5. Biases: Respects mortals more than Kindred, seeing vampires as cowardly cheaters.

6. The Hidden Secret: He actively hopes the coterie humiliates and kills Montgomery.

7. Active Memories: Views the coterie as potential, honorable challengers.

6. Prince/Baron Alaric (The Traitor)

Basic Information

  • Name: Alaric
  • Gender/Pronouns: Male (He/Him)
  • Concept: Visionary leader turned desperate collaborator
  • Predator: Siren
  • Chronicle: The Louisville Chronicle
  • Ambition: To maintain absolute control over the newly unified Louisville at any cost.
  • Clan: Lasombra
  • Organization: Varies (Camarilla or Anarch)
  • Sire: A shadowy European bishop
  • Desire: To purge all political rivals using the Second Inquisition.
  • Generation: 7th or 8th (The Target of Diablerie)
  • Blood Potency: 4
  • True Age: ~400 years
  • Apparent Age: Late 40s
  • Date of Birth: 1500s
  • Date of Death: Late 1500s
  • Appearance: Commands the room. Wears dark, modern executive clothing in the 2000s. Casts no reflection.
  • Distinguishing Features: Shadows seem to cling to him and move against the light source.
  • History: Unified Louisville vampirically just as the mortal city merged. When his power was threatened, he secretly struck a deal with hunters.

7-Point Profile

1. Mask vs. Truth: A grand, visionary unifier (Mask) vs. A cowardly tyrant collaborating with hunters (Truth).

2. Current Want: To use the merger as cover to execute his rivals via SI strikes.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never willingly surrender his throne.

4. Mannerisms: Speaks in grand historical metaphors; drinks from ancient chalices.

5. Biases: Views younger vampires as inherently disposable pawns.

6. The Hidden Secret: He has a direct radio link to the SI Commander, feeding them haven addresses.

7. Active Memories: Views the coterie as his most dangerous, imminent threat.

7. The Arbiter (Global Sect Leader)

Basic Information

  • Name: The Arbiter (Title used over real name)
  • Gender/Pronouns: Non-Binary / Unknown (They/Them)
  • Concept: Unblinking judge of Kindred law
  • Predator: Consensualist (Cult)
  • Chronicle: The Louisville Chronicle
  • Ambition: To enforce the global traditions and eliminate weak leadership.
  • Clan: Tremere (if Justicar) or Gangrel (if Warlord)
  • Organization: Varies (Camarilla or Anarch)
  • Sire: Unknown Methuselah
  • Desire: To test the coterie to see if they are worthy of replacing Alaric.
  • Generation: 6th
  • Blood Potency: 6
  • True Age: 800+ years
  • Apparent Age: Indeterminate
  • Date of Birth: Pre-Renaissance
  • Date of Death: Pre-Renaissance
  • Appearance: Varies. Radiates an overwhelming, crushing aura of ancient power.
  • Distinguishing Features: Eyes that betray absolutely no human emotion.
  • History: One of the highest-ranking vampires globally. They treat cities like petri dishes to observe Kindred evolution.

7-Point Profile

1. Mask vs. Truth: An impartial judge of the law (Mask) vs. A ruthless executioner seeking an excuse to purge (Truth).

2. Current Want: Irrefutable proof of Alaric's crimes.

3. Line in the Sand: Will not act on hearsay; requires hard evidence.

4. Mannerisms: Perfectly still; never blinks during conversation.

5. Biases: Respects raw power and ambition above all else.

6. The Hidden Secret: Deliberately leaked a small amount of intel to the SI to trigger a stress-test of the coterie.

7. Active Memories: Intrigued by the coterie's meteoric rise since the 1920s.

8. Commander Striker (The SI Leader)

Basic Information

  • Name: Commander Striker
  • Gender/Pronouns: Male (He/Him)
  • Concept: Fanatical anti-vampire zealot
  • Predator: N/A (Mortal)
  • Chronicle: The Louisville Chronicle
  • Ambition: To cleanse Louisville of every single "Blankbody."
  • Clan: Mortal (Second Inquisition)
  • Organization: Second Inquisition
  • Sire: N/A
  • Desire: To capture the coterie alive for vivisection.
  • Generation: N/A
  • Blood Potency: N/A
  • True Age: 45
  • Apparent Age: 45
  • Date of Birth: 1981
  • Date of Death: N/A
  • Appearance: Tactical UV-reflective gear, military buzzcut, heavily scarred face.
  • Distinguishing Features: Wears a prominently displayed silver crucifix.
  • History: A military veteran recruited into the SI after his squad was wiped out by a Sabbat pack.

7-Point Profile

1. Mask vs. Truth: A righteous protector of humanity (Mask) vs. A fanatic willing to cause massive mortal collateral damage (Truth).

2. Current Want: To secure a high-profile kill to maintain government funding.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never negotiate or compromise with vampires.

4. Mannerisms: Uses excessive military jargon; constantly checks his weapons.

5. Biases: Believes all vampires are mindless parasites with no remaining humanity.

6. The Hidden Secret: His unit is acting completely off-the-books and will be disavowed if they fail.

7. Active Memories: Views the coterie as his ultimate white whale.

9. Detective Sarah Miller (The Ghoul Investigator)

Basic Information

  • Name: Sarah Miller
  • Gender/Pronouns: Female (She/Her)
  • Concept: Hardboiled detective trapped by the blood
  • Predator: N/A (Ghoul)
  • Chronicle: The Louisville Chronicle
  • Ambition: To protect her mortal daughter and break her blood bond.
  • Clan: Ghoul (Mortal)
  • Organization: Independent
  • Sire: Domitor: Valerius

  • Generation: N/A
  • Blood Potency: N/A
  • True Age: 35
  • Apparent Age: 35
  • Date of Birth: 1945 (if met in 1980s)
  • Date of Death: N/A
  • Appearance: Wrinkled trench coat, circles under her eyes, always holding a coffee cup.

1. Mask vs. Truth: A hardboiled, loyal enforcer (Mask) vs. A desperate, addicted mother (Truth).

2. Current Want: To frame the coterie for murders to close Valerius's loose ends.

3. Line in the Sand: Will never do anything that puts her mortal daughter in danger.

4. Mannerisms: Chain-smoker; taps ashes into empty cups.

5. Biases: Hates all vampires, even her Domitor, but is trapped by supernatural addiction.
